subject: Insurance
title: Moral Hazard in Healthcare
description: Learn Moral Hazard in Healthcare in one minute.

hook.text: When someone else pays the bill, you spend more. Insured patients visit doctors 40% more often than uninsured ones.

buildup.text: Moral hazard means insured people use more care because they don't bear the full cost. This drives spending up.

discovery.text: Copays and deductibles exist to create 'skin in the game.' You pay $30 per visit so you think twice before going.

climax.text: Insurance must balance access against overuse. Too generous and costs explode. Too stingy and people avoid needed care.

punchline.text: 40% more visits when insured. Your copay exists to slow you down.

quiz.question: Why do insurance plans require copays?
options: To reduce overuse by giving patients 'skin in the game'
